MIGraphX dynamic-shape compile fails on ResNet-50: fused concat+pointwise JIT kernel generated with wrong arity (needs >=7 args, 4 provided) on gfx90a/ROCm 7.2.1/MIGraphX 2.15. Fixed-batch compiles fine; trivial dynamic CNN works. Reproducer+writeup: findings/migraphx-trt-shim-gaps/. Blocks dynamic batch on concat-heavy real models in trt-shim-rocm.

trt-shim-rocm int8 calibration cache not implemented. TensorRT's IInt8Calibrator has readCalibrationCache/writeCalibrationCache so the computed per-tensor int8 dynamic ranges can be persisted and reused, skipping recalibration on later builds (and enabling calibration-data-free builds). The shim runs calibration every build and ignores the cache: it neither consumes a provided cache (readCalibrationCache) nor emits one (writeCalibrationCache). Gap: MIGraphX does not expose the int8 scales it computes (no setDynamicRange/get-scales equivalent), so producing or consuming a TensorRT-compatible calibration cache needs either a MIGraphX scale accessor or a Q/DQ-in-ONNX explicit-quantization path. Resume by mapping readCalibrationCache to a Q/DQ pre-quantized model path, or request a MIGraphX scale get/set API.

MIGraphX segfaults evaluating a dynamic-dim program compiled with offload_copy=false: crash in op::select_module::compute -> shape::operator== (dynamic dispatch). offload_copy=true dynamic works; offload_copy=false static works; only dynamic+offload_copy=false crashes. Forces trt-shim-rocm to keep dynamic engines on the non-graph-capturable offload_copy=true host-staging path (static engines use offload_copy=false zero-copy + HIP graph capture). gfx90a/ROCm 7.2.1/MIGraphX 2.15. Repro: compile any dynamic-batch ONNX with offload_copy=false, eval.

MIGraphX gfx1100: offload_copy=false fp32 eval returns zeros after double-compile + save/load round-trip. Blocks fp32 static engine correctness on gfx1100. fp16 and dynamic paths unaffected; gfx90a unaffected.
